title: FHFA House Price Index, conforming loan limits and Public Use Databases (fhfa.gov files)
questions: latest FHFA house price index for the U.S., seasonally adjusted
house price growth by state over the last year
home price appreciation in a metro area since 2020
annual house price index by county
2026 conforming loan limit for a one-unit home in a county
which counties have high-cost loan limits

manual.how: Open each link in manual_download/INSTRUCTIONS.md in a browser; the file downloads (hpi_master.csv is 17 MB). Upload it under the name shown; the pack applies the request's filters to the uploaded file. Without the links: HPI files are listed on https://www.fhfa.gov/data/hpi/datasets, conforming loan limits on https://www.fhfa.gov/data/conforming-loan-limit, Public Use Databases on https://www.fhfa.gov/data/pudb.

cache.why: Files are overwritten in place at each release (monthly HPI, quarterly, annual); data/ is reused only within a run.

redistribution.why: FHFA data are works of a U.S. government agency, in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); cite FHFA as the source.

citation: Federal Housing Finance Agency, {dataset}, www.fhfa.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which index: purchase-only (the flagship, sales only) or all-transactions (adds refinance appraisals, longer history)? Default: purchase-only.
Seasonally adjusted or not? Default: seasonally adjusted for month-to-month or quarter-to-quarter changes, not adjusted for year-over-year changes.
Which loan limit: the baseline (most counties) or a specific county's limit (high-cost areas are higher), and for how many units? Default: one-unit.
